description: This file contains functional tests for the 'Basket' web page in an e-commerce application, specifically testing the update functionality (e.g., changing item quantities) using HTTP client requests within a test suite.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the basket page's functionality including updating item quantities and emptying the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Tests that updating an item's quantity to 50 successfully reflects in the cart and total amount.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Tests that setting an item's quantity to zero empties the basket and shows the appropriate message.
